data.title: Remove dark bezel around drawing surface — light well so black ink stays visible

data.body: Implemented light well: app+demo .bezel now --ground with 1px --key-border and softened inset (rgba(35,35,32,.18)); minimap hairlines flipped to ink-on-light in chrome.ts; letterbox comments updated in grid-editor.ts; BRANDING.md §5 bezel bullet rewritten plus §3 charcoal token/rules no longer list the canvas bezel (needed so doc agrees with app per acceptance). tsc --noEmit and npm run build clean. Remaining charcoal verified as LCD/badge/active keys only. Commit 32f0874.

Reviewed commit 32f0874 cold against the plan. Verified: (1) no charcoal adjacent to the drawing surface in app or demo — app .bezel is --ground (#D3D2CD, defined in src/styles/tokens.css) with 1px --key-border edge and softened inset shadow; .editor-canvas is background:transparent so the letterbox shows the light bezel; demo .bezel matches and its #canvas is --paper. (2) Minimap flipped to ink-on-light (rgba(35,35,32,.45) hairlines, .18 center hollow, orange fill kept); other letterbox chrome (delineation, center lock) was already ink-tone. (3) All remaining charcoal usages are information surfaces only — badge (.model), active tool/size keys, stepper readout, LCD — in both app.css and demo. (4) BRANDING.md consistent: 'device's screen' phrase removed, section 3 token table and rules no longer claim the bezel, section 5 bezel bullet rewritten as light well; no stale mentions found by grep. (5) npx tsc --noEmit and npm run build both clean. No defects, no inline fixes needed. Verdict: pass — meets all acceptance criteria.
